text.p: Tele-Communications Inc said on Friday it named Leo Hindery president, succeeding Chairman John Malone who relinquished the president's post.
Most recently, Hindery was managing general partner and chief executive of InterMedia Partners, a San Francisco-based cable operator that is partly owned by TCI..

TCI said it is negotiating to purchase Hindery's management company, which now manages the InterMedia cable properties. However, it said, InterMedia will continue to be separately owned and managed by parties other than TCI.
The company said that the chief executives of TCI's business units -- communications, programming, international and technology -- will report to Hindery.
"Leo will bring considerable financial talents and operating experience to bear on a number of business issues that have the attention of our management team," Malone said in a statement.
He has managed effectively a rapidly growing cable unit, and his leadership will be valuable to all in our company who are working to advance our businesses."
